The '''Marat system''', also known as the '''Skye system''', was located in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. This [[Star system/Legends|system]] contained the [[Star/Legends|star]] [[Marat Prime]] and the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Skye/Legends|Skye]].
